_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Full Maintenance Manual (Type III)
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for a Full Maintenance Manual (Type III), which combines limited and depot maintenance manual elements into one manual for minor equipment items.
use_relationship:
The maintenance manual combines elements of a limited maintenance manual (Type I) and depot maintenance manual (Type II) into a single manual. It is generally used in lieu of manual Types I and II for minor units of equipment where there is no need for a separate limited maintenance manual (Type I).

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract and paragraphs 2-1, 3-1, 4-1, 4-2, and 5-3 of DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval date and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein. preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Full Maintenance Manual (Type III) shall be in accordance with the format and style requirements of paragraphs 2-1, 3-1, and 4-1 of DS-56.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The textbook content shall be in accordance with paragraphs 4-2 and 5-3 of DS-56.
